value.rationale: The result characterizes every VC-shattered ordered-pair query digraph for all finite n and b, determines exact VC dimensions for arbitrary component cap, and determines exact Littlestone dimensions through component cap four. The exact gap vanishes at bounds one and two and grows as floor(n/3) already with comparability components of order at most three. These are genuine structural and online consequences beyond an isolated finite enumeration.
